title: Show the touch menu button above the D-pad
changes: Show the Menu touch control above the D-pad by default, following the D-pad until moved separately; migrate older layouts while preserving customized positions and other controls.
validation: Android ARM64 Docker build and 26 Kotlin unit tests passed in android-touch-menu-apk-1edzetc3, including default placement and drag unanchoring.
Installed the APK as an update on the connected moto g34 5G using adb install -r; package retained its original first-install time.
limitations: The on-device button appearance and tapping behavior were not manually verified.
